requested_remedy: Hong Kong Golden Source Limited (HKGSL) sought to enforce an award made by the China International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission, South China Sub-Commission, No 92 of 2009, dated 29 June 2009 (the Award) against New Elegant Investment Limited and Wide United Inc.

Defendant: New Elegant Investment Limited (漢新投資有限公司) (1st Respondent), Wide United Inc (廣聯有限公司) (2nd Respondent)

facts.F1: The subject matter of the dispute between the parties is a 95% shareholding (2,850,000 shares, “the Shares”) in a Hong Kong company, Sealight Trading Company Limited (Sealight).
facts.F2: The Shares are currently registered in the names of New Elegant (90% or 2,700,000 shares) and Wide United (5% or 150,000 shares).
facts.F3: Their estimated value is between RMB20 million to 40 million.
facts.F4: In or about 2005, the Shares were transferred by HKGSL to New Elegant and Wide United, being nominees of China Guanfa Bank (CGB), pursuant to three written agreements all dated 2 February 2005 between HKGSL and (i) CGB, (ii) New Elegant, and (iii) Wide United respectively (the Three Agreements).
facts.F5: Subsequently, HKGSL alleged that CGB breached its agreement with HKGSL, and the dispute between them was referred to arbitration in July 2008.
facts.F6: By the Award, it was adjudged that the Three Agreements be discharged, and New Elegant and Wide United were ordered to transfer the Shares back to HKGSL.
facts.F7: Apparently, New Elegant and Wide United have failed or refused to comply with the Award and thus the Shares are currently still held or registered in their names.
facts.F8: HKGSL commenced the arbitration proceedings, and subsequently the proceedings herein, without the knowledge or consent of Guo Hong Qi (Guo).
facts.F9: Guo asserts that he is the beneficial owner of the Shares, which were held by HKGSL as his nominee, and that HKGSL entered into the Three Agreements with CGB, New Elegant and Wide United respectively upon Guo's instruction.
facts.F10: Guo commenced the High Court Action against HKGSL seeking a declaration that he is the true beneficial owner of (inter alia) all the 3,000,000 issued shares in Sealight, and an order for the delivery up of those shares to Guo or his nominee.
facts.F11: The primary supervisory function in respect of arbitration rests with the court of supervisory jurisdiction, ie the Mainland courts in respect of Mainland awards, as distinct from the enforcement court, ie the Hong Kong courts.
facts.F12: The relevant public policy is that of the country in which the enforcement is sought and not that of the country in which the award was made.
